welcome.title: Care for every day after a stroke
welcome.lead: Follow your recovery plan, keep track of blood pressure and medicines, and share it with the people who help you.
welcome.safety: StrokeCare records what you enter. It does not diagnose, prescribe or replace emergency care.

auth.name: Your name
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Avoid common words.

roles.survivorHint: Recovering at home after a stroke
roles.preventionHint: Looking after my health to prevent a stroke
roles.caregiverHint: Helping someone who had a stroke

consent.title: Before you start
consent.draft: These notices are drafts. The final legal text is not written yet.

privacy_notice.title: Privacy notice
privacy_notice.body: We keep your account details to run the app. You can download or delete everything at any time from Settings.
privacy_notice.agree: I have read the privacy notice

health_data.title: Your health records
health_data.body: We store the readings, answers and notes you enter. Only you, and the people you choose to share with, can see them. Every time someone else opens them, it is recorded.
health_data.agree: I agree that my health records are stored and processed

today.unread: {n} new messages from your care team

checkin.title: Daily check-in
checkin.leadOther: Answer for the person you care for. Any question can be skipped.
checkin.thanks: Thank you. Your check-in is saved.
checkin.oneScreen: Answer what you like and skip the rest. Anything left empty is sent as skipped.

emergency.title: Emergency help
emergency.message: If you think you or someone near you may be having a stroke or another emergency, contact your local emergency services now. Do not wait for this app.
emergency.fallback: If you think you or someone near you may be having a stroke or another emergency, contact your local emergency services now. Do not wait for this app.
emergency.noVerified: No verified number for your area yet. Call your local emergency services the way you normally would.

bp.title: Blood pressure
bp.hint: Write the numbers your blood pressure device shows. Unit: mmHg.
bp.topAboveBottom: The top number should be larger than the bottom number. Please check it.

meds.title: Medicines
meds.summary: {n} of {total} doses marked as taken today
meds.undo: Marked as taken. Tap to undo.
meds.onlyClinician: Only your clinician can change this list. If something looks wrong, add it to
meds.allDone: All of today's doses are marked.

talk.title: Talk board
talk.lead: Tap a picture. The phone shows the words large and says them out loud.
talk.voiceOn: Your phone reads the words aloud.
talk.voiceOff: Your phone has no voice for this language, so the words are shown large instead.

learn.title: Learn
learn.lead: Every item shows where it comes from and whether it has been reviewed.
learn.fellBack: Not yet available in your language, so shown in English.

visit.title: Questions for my visit
visit.lead: Write or record questions when you think of them.

voice.noMic: The microphone is not available. Check the phone's permission.

messages.title: Messages
messages.notice: Messages are not for emergencies and are not watched all the time.

calendar.title: Care calendar
calendar.lead: Who does what, and notes for the next person.
calendar.empty: Nothing planned in the next 30 days.
calendar.handoverWrite: Leave a note for the next person

care.noPeople: Nobody has shared with you yet. Ask the person for their code.
care.alertNote: Alerts are not an emergency service.

alerts.urgent_answer: {name} answered Yes to the urgent check-in question ({date}).
alerts.no_check_in: {name} has not checked in for {days} days.
alerts.doses_not_marked: {count} doses were not marked as taken by {name} yesterday.

caseload.title: Your patients
caseload.factsOnly: Facts only: dates and counts the person entered. There is no risk score and no ranking.

summary.title: Summary
summary.disclaimer: A description of what the person entered. It is not a diagnosis and not medical advice.
summary.urgentDays: Days the urgent question was answered Yes: {n}

templates.title: Plan templates
templates.lead: Task lists you reuse. Adding one copies the tasks into a person's plan.
templates.name: Template name

chw.title: Home visits
chw.lead: The people who asked you to visit them.
chw.empty: Nobody has shared with you yet. Ask the person for their code.

visitLog.lead: Works without signal. It is sent when you are back online.
visitLog.readingHint: Only if you took a reading during this visit.

items.medicines_reviewed: Went through the medicine list together
items.health_centre_advised: Advised a visit to the health centre

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.leadPatient: You choose who sees your records, and you can stop at any time.
sharing.leadMember: Enter the code the person gave you.
sharing.label: Their name (optional)
sharing.confirmEnd: Stop sharing? They will lose access at once.
sharing.waiting: Waiting for them to enter the code

scopes.caregiver: They can see your plan, readings, medicines and check-ins, add readings and tick tasks for you, and use the calendar and messages.
scopes.clinician: They can see your records, write your recovery plan and medicine list, and message your care team.
scopes.chw: They can see your records, take readings at home visits, record visits, and use the calendar and messages.

more.caregiver: They can also see and add to your movement log, goals and personal phrases.
more.clinician: They can also see your movement log and goals, and write your recovery stages.
more.chw: They can also see and add to your movement log, goals and personal phrases.

settings.title: Me
settings.translationNote: Kinyarwanda and French texts are drafts until a native speaker reviews them.
settings.deleteHint: This removes your account and every record. It cannot be undone.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete your account and all your records for good?
settings.notVerified: Your professional account is waiting for verification by an administrator.

prefHint.easy_read_font: Letters that are harder to mix up
prefHint.reduce_motion: No sliding, fading or moving parts
prefHint.one_question_at_a_time: A calmer check-in with big buttons
prefHint.one_handed_layout: Main buttons stay within thumb reach

settings.offlineCopy: Keep my plan on this phone
settings.offlineCopyHint: Lets you see your plan, medicines, appointments and phrases without a connection. It stays on this phone until you sign out, so turn it on only for a phone that is yours alone.
settings.offlineCopyRemoved: The saved copy was removed from this phone.

offline.notice: You are offline. What you enter is kept and sent later.
offline.saved: Saved on this phone. It will be sent when you are online.
offline.copyShown: You are offline. Showing what was last saved on this phone.

recovery.title: My recovery
recovery.lead: Your stage, your goals and your movement in one place.
recovery.noStage: Your clinician has not set a stage yet.
recovery.noStageOther: No stage has been set yet.
recovery.goalLead: What do you want to be able to do? Write it in your own words.

mobility.title: Movement
mobility.lead: Write down how you moved. There is no right amount.
mobility.leadOther: Write down how they moved. There is no right amount.

help.with_aid: With a stick, frame or other aid

progress.title: Progress
progress.lead: What was written down, day by day. These are counts, not a score.
progress.chart: The bars show counts for each day. The same numbers are in the table below.

phase.title: Recovery stages
phase.lead: Name each stage of this person's recovery in your own words. The current stage shows on their Today screen.
phase.name: Name of the stage

team.title: My care team
team.lead: These people can see your records, because you chose to share.
team.none: Nobody yet. Share a code to invite someone.

doctor.people: {n} person shares with you | {n} people share with you
doctor.needs: People who may need a look
doctor.needsLead: Facts they entered. Listed by name, not by importance.

reasons.urgent: Answered Yes to the urgent question this week
reasons.no_check_in: No check-in for 2 days or more
reasons.doses_not_marked: Doses not marked as taken yesterday

doctor.none: Nothing needs a look right now.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.lead: Reminders show inside the app. Phone alerts by SMS or push are not available yet.

phrases.title: My own phrases
phrases.lead: Add the words this person needs most. They appear first on the talk board.
